articles.title: MIT astronomers catch a star in a feast that could last billions of years
articles.summary: Astronomers have discovered a bizarre star system about 300 light-years from Earth where a small star is slowly devouring a nearby brown dwarf, an object too massive to be a planet but too small to be a true star.
